transferScope: semantic VK color and type roles
Lucide product chrome with native platform actions
nonTransferable: product actions not present in the selected World Model

implementationRecipes.shell: Compose every root with VKRootSurface so the white top safe area, VKTabHeader and content alignment are identical. Use the system TabView solely for Liquid Glass. Its labels are icon-only template assets from NativeVisualLanguage.requiredTabIconAsset; accessible names stay semantic and are not rendered as extra captions.
implementationRecipes.feed: Use VKRootSurface, then ScrollView/LazyVStack with VKAuthoredPost and GroupGap. VKAuthoredPost must own author/meta header, product text/media and the attached VKPostActions; never render feedback as a separate panel.
implementationRecipes.navigation: Use VKNavigationChrome and VKModalChrome for pushed and modal product surfaces. Do not let automatic toolbar glass create capsules in VK content chrome.
implementationRecipes.messages: Follow native/apps/looks/Messaging.swift for conversation rows, compact chat header, message grouping, composer attachment and keyboard-safe bottom spacing.
implementationRecipes.profile: Follow native/apps/looks/Profile.swift for one profile entry, VKGroup/VKRow anatomy, section hierarchy and predictable chevrons only on navigable rows.
implementationRecipes.contentBoundary: Transfer only components declared in ReferenceProfiles/vk-ios/profile.json compositionCatalog. Preserve the new product World Model, entities, copy, journeys and actions without importing Looks-specific features. Decorative selectors and unowned affordances are prohibited.
implementationRecipes.forms: Use VKModalChrome, native fields/sections and VKPrimaryActionArea. Keep 16pt below the primary button and show permission recovery through VKInlineNotice, never through a fake system prompt.

transferScope: one component family per semantic role
